usedFor: LiveChat is where conversations start, and “New Chat” there can create a contact in LeadConnector, which holds your CRM records.

bestTemplate.name: “Finished Chat” in LiveChat, then “Add/Remove Tags to Contact” in LeadConnector
bestTemplate.why: When a chat ends, the contact can be tagged, found by email or phone.

watchOut: “Create Contact” on each “New Chat” can duplicate a visitor, so “Create Or Update Contact” is safer for returning people.
